Job description:
Rahand Hooshmand Knowledge-based company is looking to attract a Python Software Engineer with experience in developing Backend services, designing software systems, and solving complex technical problems within its Artificial Intelligence team. The desired individual, in addition to mastering software engineering principles, will be interested in working in the field of Artificial Intelligence and developing the software infrastructure required for intelligent systems. This position is suitable for someone who can play an effective role in the design, development, and optimization of Production services and continue their growth path in the field of AI Engineering. The Rahand Hooshmand AI team operates in areas such as Digital Identity (KYC), Agentic AI, RAG, Document Processing (OCR), and communication systems. The main focus of this position is the development of scalable, stable, and maintainable Backend services that are used as the infrastructure for intelligent systems. Responsibilities include designing, developing, and maintaining Backend services with FastAPI or Django / DRF, designing and developing RESTful APIs and extensible software services, designing and optimizing databases and queries with PostgreSQL, developing scalable services for concurrent and high-volume requests, participating in system architecture design and technical decision-making, developing and integrating Backend services with AI models and services, including LLMs and Agents, developing the necessary software workflows and infrastructure for AI-based systems, containerizing services with Docker, adhering to software development standards, testability, and code maintenance. Required skills include mastery of Python and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, practical experience in Backend development with FastAPI or Django / DRF, a good understanding of HTTP, REST architecture, and API design, experience working with PostgreSQL and database design and optimization principles, experience developing scalable and Production-ready services, familiarity with LLM, RAG, and designing Agentic AI systems (such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex), conceptual mastery of Async Programming, Concurrency, and parallel processing in Python, experience analyzing and optimizing the performance of Backend services, familiarity with Docker and Git, a good understanding of software design and System Design principles, the ability to analyze problems, make technical decisions, and collaborate effectively in a team. Bonus skills include familiarity with Tool Calling, Function Calling, and Memory in Agent design, experience with Unit Testing and Clean Architecture, experience with Real-time / WebSocket, familiarity with CI/CD, experience with Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ, or other Queue tools, familiarity with Event-driven architecture, and familiarity with Observability and Monitoring (such as Prometheus/Grafana). Benefits include participation in the development of AI-based products in the finance and banking sector, opportunity for specialized growth in the path of AI Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Software Architecture, the possibility of receiving a tax exemption for employees in a technical, dynamic, and learning-based work environment, and compensation and supplementary insurance proportional to ability and impact, flexible working hours, and Thursday holidays.

Company description:
Rahand Hooshmand, a knowledge-based company, has started its activities based on expertise, experience, and local knowledge with the mission of developing innovative solutions in the field of information technology and a special focus on the digitalization of processes and businesses. By utilizing the proprietary platform "Edo-Hooshmand," this company has been able to design and implement a set of integrated organizational systems for the country's financial, banking, and service industries. In recent years, Rahand Hooshmand has succeeded in developing and providing solutions, relying on the technical capabilities of its specialists, which address complex organizational needs with the three characteristics of agility, scalability, and security. Our company's areas of activity are: * Remote banking and payment services systems * Customized process solutions for leasing, facilities, and validation * Digital marketplace for services and goods connected to banking platforms * Design and development of organizational platforms based on modern architecture and cutting-edge technologies. With an approach based on local technologies and international standards, Rahand Hooshmand has established its role as a strategic partner for banks and large organizations. We believe that digital transformation is achieved when technology is put in the service of ease, efficiency, and security; and this belief is the driving force behind the development of our products and services. The Rahand Hooshmand team is composed of specialized, young, and creative personnel who continuously move towards improving product quality and creating added value for customers in the software industry. Relying on an organizational culture based on learning, innovation, and responsibility, we strive to build a smarter future for the financial industry and the country's organizations.
